description.narrative: Poverty-Environment Action Technical Assistance initiatives in support of PEA. A maximum of 10 Initiatives are envisages under this output.

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

description.narrative:
1.1 Number of planning frameworks, legislation and regulations that integrate the poverty-environment nexus (per country) 1.2 Policy positions(s) on poverty-environment issues formulated by non-government actors 1.3 Number of government-led inter-sectoral coordination mechanisms that promote coherence of planning, frameworks, legislation and regulations 1.4 Number of countries where environmental/social/economic data are collected, analysed and reported applying a poverty-environment nexus perspective through national development and SDG monitoring systems
2.1: Number of key budget policy documents (e.g. budget statements, economic surveys, budget call circulars) that reflect environmental sustainability and climate priorities for poverty eradication (per country) 2.2. Number of countries with increased annual and medium-term sector budget allocations (including national and sub-national levels) that reflect environmental sustainability and climate for poverty eradication 2.3: Number of countries with fiscal instruments (tax, incentives, user fees, etc.) adopted in policies and regulations that prioritise quality investments 2.4: Number of guidelines and tools to manage private sector investment decisions that facilitate or prioritize quality investments

comment.narrative: 4 Technical Assistance proposals approved and implemented (Gender, Green Economy, Millennium Institute and Blue Economy) 2. Partnerships developed with other development agencies/ institutions to strengthen policy approaches and implementation of integrated development approach 3. Multiple case studies and best practices in poverty environment mainstreaming produced and disseminated. 4. South South Knowledge transfer and Corporation enhanced (Indonesia and South Africa)

Implement all approved TAs; 1. Establish a capacity building platform and helpdesk. 2. Develop a Hand Book on Green Bonds for Municipalities in South Africa. 3. Finalize and disseminate the joint regional report on planning and financing a blue economy in Asia Pacific 4. Conduct evidence-based capacity building of targeted governments on integrating gender sensitive Climate Smart Agriculture (CSA) approaches in policies

1. Helpdesk developed on the project webpage and capacity building platform still under development. 2. Hand Book on Green Bonds for Municipalities in South Africa developed. 3. Joint regional report on planning and financing a blue economy in Asia Pacific with Asia Development Bank (ADB) finalized, dissemination to commence in 2022. 4. A draft report on the gender gap in agricultural productivity in Zimbabwe has been developed and will inform capacity building for governments on integrating gender sensitive Climate Smart Agriculture.

- Establish capacity building platform. - Update Handbook on mainstreaming on poverty environment. - Finalize and launch the Hand Book on Green Bonds for Municipalities in South Africa and Gender Gap Report for Zimbabwe.
